NENHUMA ROTA, BALSA, ILHA OU NADO
texto_aprovado: Genetic dating puts the family's spread across the world's continents at roughly 25 to 30 million years ago. That's an estimate, and it falls before Australia and Asia met. By that estimate, the snakes got to Australia before Australia got to Asia. How they crossed the water, the dating doesn't say.
